remarks: Fall in love with this immaculate and updated Storybook Charmer, nestled on half an acre in a special enclave near town and beach and train. Step inside and be delighted by the front-to- back Living Room with vaulted beamed ceilings, gleaming hardwood floors, fireplace and french doors from the Dining Area that opens to a large private deck. Also on the main level you will find the well-appointed Kitchen ( also opening to the deck) the cozy, sunfilled Family Room and the Primary Bedroom with Full Bath and sliders to a private patio. Upstairs discover a perfect Den/Office tucked away for quiet time. The above grade lower level features 2 additional lovely Bedrooms that share a Bath. This enchanting home is available as a yearly rental in June 2026. Tenant must have excellent credit and good references.
